gloss: to dress up, to deck oneself out

definitions.gloss: to dress up, to deck oneself out
definitions.explanation: To put on fine or elaborate clothing in order to look one's best.

examples.japanese: パーティーに{着飾|きかざ}って{出|で}かけた。
examples.english: I dressed up and went to the party.

examples.japanese: {華|はな}やかに{着飾|きかざ}った{女性|じょせい}たち。
{結婚式|けっこんしき}の{招待客|しょうたいきゃく}はみな{美|うつく}しく{着飾|きかざ}っていた。
examples.english: The wedding guests were all beautifully dressed up.

notes:
CONJUGATION: Godan る-verb. {着飾|きかざ}る → {着飾|きかざ}って → {着飾|きかざ}った.

USAGE: A compound verb from {着|き}る (to wear) + {飾|かざ}る (to decorate). Implies dressing up beyond one's everyday attire, often for a special occasion. Usually positive in tone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {華|はな}やかに{着飾|きかざ}る: to dress up splendidly
- {美|うつく}しく{着飾|きかざ}る: to dress up beautifully
- {着飾|きかざ}った{姿|すがた}: a dressed-up appearance
